params.cid: Metadata CID assigned to the internal procedures registry organ.
params.salt: Deterministic salt used to deploy the procedures registry organ.
params.trustedForwarder: ERC-2771 forwarder trusted by freshly deployed clones.

params.initialSupply: Initial token supply minted to the caller.
params.name: Token name.

returns.clone: Address of the deployed asset clone.

returns.clones: Addresses of the deployed asset clones.

params._permissionAddresses: Addresses receiving permissions on the organ.
params.cid: Metadata CID assigned to the deployed organ.
params.entries: Initial entries stored on the organ.

returns.clone: Address of the deployed organ clone.

returns.clones: Addresses of the deployed organ clones.

params.data: Optional initialization calldata executed immediately after deployment.

returns.procedure: Address of the deployed procedure clone.

returns.created: Addresses of the deployed procedure clones.

returns._0: True if `forwarder` is trusted by this contract.

params.entries: Registry entries that point to valid procedure implementations.

returns._0: The forwarder allowed to relay signed calls on behalf of users.

constructor.notice: Deploy the client contract together with default organ and asset implementations.

deployAsset(string,string,uint256,bytes3.notice: Deploy a single asset clone and initialize it as an ERC-20 token.

deployAssets((string,string,uint256,byte.notice: Deploy several asset clones in one call.

deployOrgan(address[],bytes2[],string,(a.notice: Deploy a single organ clone and initialize it.

deployOrganigram((address[],bytes2[],str.notice: Deploy a complete organigram in one transaction.

deployOrgans((address[],bytes2[],string,.notice: Deploy several organ clones in one call.

deployProcedure(address,bytes,bytes32).notice: Deploy one procedure clone from a registered procedure implementation.

deployProcedures((address,bytes,bytes32).notice: Deploy several procedure clones in one call.

isTrustedForwarder(address).notice: Return whether an address is the trusted ERC-2771 forwarder.

registerProcedures((address,string)[]).notice: Register supported procedure implementations in the procedures registry.

trustedForwarder().notice: Return the trusted ERC-2771 forwarder used by this contract.
